entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The chaotic space between planes in the Multiverse, filled with Aether, mana and temporal energy, that only planeswalkers and godlike beings can survive.

entities.name: The Edge
entities.description: The region outside the Multiverse, on the other side of the Chaos Wall.

entities.name: Chaos Wall
entities.description: The boundary at which the Blind Eternities end, with the Edge on the other side.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker who recalls that even ghosts may die in the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A being who saw the Blind Eternities as an endless space like crushed velvet.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who sees the Blind Eternities as endlessly intricate layers of glass.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The creator of the Infinity Globes that allow planeswalkers to interact in the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Ishikari Bindra
entities.description: An inventor from Avishkar who grabbed a piece of the Blind Eternities to create the artificial Aetherspark and died in the process.

entities.name: Aetherspark
entities.description: An artificial spark created from a piece of the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Unfathomable beings that exist in the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: An artifact whose branches tore paths through the Blind Eternities for the Machine Legion's invasion.

entities.name: Machine Legion
entities.description: The Phyrexian force that invaded other planes through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who detonated a replica of the Golgothian Sylex in the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: A weapon of which Elspeth detonated a replica.

entities.name: Sundering of Alara
entities.description: An extremely powerful outburst that separated Alara's shards, which drifted apart in the Eternities.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The reunion movement of the Alaran shards, observed with surprise.

entities.name: Mark Rosewater
entities.description: A real-world designer who describes the Blind Eternities as a doorway, not a physical space.

events.summary: Elspeth Tirel detonates a replica of the Golgothian Sylex in the Blind Eternities to protect planes connected to New Phyrexia, potentially causing a Multiversal spark rupture.
events.quote: Elspeth Tirel detonated a replica of the Golgothian Sylex in the Blind Eternities

events.summary: Realmbreaker's branches tear paths through the Blind Eternities, opening the way for the Machine Legion to invade other planes.
events.quote: Realmbreaker 's branches were capable of tearing paths through the Blind Eternities and opening the way for the Machine Legion to invade other planes.

events.summary: Ishikari Bindra grabs a piece of the Blind Eternities to create the artificial Aetherspark and dies.
events.quote: although she died in the process.

events.summary: The Sundering of Alara separates the shards, which drift apart in the Eternities, and during the Conflux move back toward each other.
events.quote: the shards separated and continued to drift further apart over time.

relations.note: They exist in the Blind Eternities.
relations.quote: The Eldrazi are unfathomable beings that exist in the Blind Eternities.

relations.note: Created it from a piece of the Blind Eternities.
The Blind Eternities end at the Chaos Wall.
relations.quote: The Blind Eternities end at the Chaos Wall , with the Edge situated on the other side.

relations.note: His Infinity Globes allow interaction within the Eternities.
relations.quote: Infinity Globes allow planeswalkers to interact with each other while in the Blind Eternities.
